ResearchProjectDef.label: dreamcatcher
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a near-intelligent microcomputer which automatically analyses new memories when the user is asleep. It will boost positive memories, making them last longer, while trying to suppress negative ones. As a positive side effect the user's will always experience pleasant dreams.

ResearchProjectDef.label: empty neural stack
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture an ultratech neural implant which can store a human consciousness, commonly referred to as a neural. Once implanted directly into a person's spine in the neck it will download their consciousness and safely store it. While the death of an organic or inorganic body is no longer a concern, being a fragile piece of technology, blunt force trauma and bullets to the neck area should be avoided at all cost.
Extremely rare, heavily restricted and hard to produce, these implants are rare on non-ultratech worlds.

ResearchProjectDef.label: mental fuse
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a non-intelligent microcomputer monitoring the user's emotional state passively. If a mental break is detected, it will cause a split second state of unconsciousness to prevent it. While effective, the technology is imperfect and has a low risk of damaging the user’s brain

ResearchProjectDef.label: arm-blade
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an advanced artificial combat focused arm. Razor-sharp, retractable and powered by silenced nano-motors which replace the radius and ulna. When extended the blade allows for devastating attacks, offering unparalleled swiftness and precision. When retracted neuromuscular synchronisation makes them appear and function like a normal arm.

ResearchProjectDef.label: voice synthesizer
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a nano-mesh controlled by a visual/tactile neural interface. It allows for dynamic adaptations of the user's vocal cord to adapt their voice to a more attractive or dominant tone, enhancing their ability to speak.
